tags.effort_rationale: Several independently rendered public pages need coordinated navigation and palette edits, plus interactive month ranking and sorting while preserving filtering.

objective: Standardize public page navigation and colors, and add filtered, sortable top/bottom monthly official sector rankings to the seasonality page.

evidence: 2026-11-01: npm run build -- --mode pages passed; Vite compiled the updated seasonality React page and CSS. The workflow uploads the tracked homepage and daily brief static HTML alongside this build.
2026-11-01: scripts/planning/validate_ticket.py accepted the PRSG-172 manifest and all seven scoped paths.
2026-11-01: git diff --check reported no whitespace errors in the complete ticket change set.

acceptance.description: Homepage, daily brief, and seasonality have consistent responsive navigation to all requested sections.
evidence: All three page headers provide Home, Reports, Technical analysis, Ticker forecasts, and Seasonality destinations; the homepage and report keep responsive menu behavior.

acceptance.description: Public pages use the daily brief's dark slate and blue/green/red theme colors.
evidence: Homepage variables and cards use the report palette; seasonality now uses the same page gradient, panel, text, line, blue, green, and red tokens.

acceptance.description: Selecting a month displays best/worst official industries based on selected period and current search; market and proxy series are excluded.
evidence: Month heading buttons select/deselect a month. Top/bottom lists derive from search-filtered heatmap values, official industry rows only, with non-finite observations excluded and disjoint lists when fewer than ten sectors match.

acceptance.description: Industry rows sort by original order, alphabetical direction, or selected-month return direction, while search remains effective.
evidence: The row sort control offers original order, A–Z, Z–A, selected-month return descending, and selected-month return ascending. Return options are enabled after selecting a month.

acceptance.description: Pages build, ticket scope validation, and whitespace check pass.
evidence: The standalone Pages build, validation of all seven ticket paths, and git diff --check passed.
